title: A modern magyar irodalom: A Nyugattól a Nobel-díjig
grammar: Literary Renewal & Moral Testimony: Megújít, tanúságot tesz, elnyer

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain how the journal Nyugat and its first generation (Ady, Móricz, Babits, Kosztolányi) modernized Hungarian literature.
I can explain the themes of Attila József's poetry and Miklós Radnóti's tragic humanist eclogues (Nem tudhatom...).
I can discuss Sándor Márai, Magda Szabó (Abigél), and Imre Kertész's Nobel Prize-winning novel Sorstalanság.
I can formulate sentences about literary prizes, moral testimony, and 20th-century cultural milestones.
